name: Omnichannel Morning FM 20.18
ticker: Morning, Xinyi District! If a mobile page takes 3 seconds, over half of people swipe away. Still loading?
One thing online, another in store? Our listeners say: that makes me mad.
Wait two or three weeks for a wrap report? The campaign window's long gone by then.
MRT crowds grew 86% in ten years, but billboards still wait for callbacks on quotes.
Today's weather: rain. Skincare ads, remember to swap your creative assets automatically.
Taiwan has nearly 2.81M single-person households. Eating alone is a business too.
A data scientist says: 80% of my time is cleaning data. Stop calling me a wizard.

name: Transformation Now FM 20.19
ticker: At the annual conference they said “Digital” is out of style. It's all “Data” now.
90% of CEOs say transformation is urgent; only 25% have a clear plan. Which is your company?
Search volume dropped? Don't panic. Look outside: has it gone days without rain?
Big data isn't all data. The uncle who never goes online is your customer too.
Gen Z's go-to platform is YouTube. Can't find your shop there? They just scroll on.
27% of Americans run ad blockers. Your ads? They never even see them.
LEGO-style coworkers transform together. Building-block coworkers only guard their own piece.

name: Second Half Radio FM 20.20
ticker: Pandemic week one: don't rush to cut the budget in half. Is your market surging or stagnating?
Everyone's used to ordering delivery now. Word is, they won't go back after the pandemic.
Chrome is saying goodbye to third-party cookies. How many members of your own do you have?
A sportswear brand moved its budget to 60% brand, 40% performance. Would your company dare?
Eyes too tired to read? Seniors say: just ask your phone out loud. It's faster.
Buying supplements at the pharmacy, people still listen to the pharmacist.
AI makes a banner in five seconds. Creatives, don't panic. Have a coffee.

name: Crossing Channel FM 20.21
ticker: One week into the Level 3 alert, public transit use is down 56%. Everyone's at home.
Home became the mall, the restaurant, the gym. Delivery speed decides who people like.
People in Taiwan spend nearly eight hours online a day, over an hour above the global average.
A real estate ad that didn't sell a single house won Taiwan's first Cannes Grand Prix.
Seniors say: don't call me old. I use LINE too.
Cookies are on their way out. Before buying new tools, count your own first-party data.

name: Compound Leap FM 20.22
ticker: 85% think eco products cost more. Did your refill pack do the math clearly?
Six months into iOS's new privacy rules, iOS ad spend is down 30%, while Android's is up.
Forty is the dividing line. Young office workers say daily progress beats rushing big projects.
New product news gets buried in a day. To be remembered, make work people want to talk about.
NFTs, the metaverse, avatars: bought any? Only 7% of netizens in Taiwan have bought an NFT.
Efficiency is poison to curiosity. This afternoon, ask “What if” just once.

name: AI Talk Radio FM 20.23
ticker: AI is learning, and we're learning AI. This is an age of conversation.
AI-drawn hands? Remember to count the fingers.
Search engines hooked up chatbots, and visits once jumped 15%. Search is turning into chat.
Garbage in, garbage out. Feed AI messy data, and it's just confidently messy.
Writing emails with AI? Remember to delete the “Generated by AI” line.
A familiar voice calls asking to borrow money? Hang up, then call them back yourself.
Italy once paused ChatGPT for nearly a month. The rules are catching up with tech.

name: Impact Broadcast FM 20.24
ticker: Everyone uses AI. Flawless execution is nothing special. What's rare is a brand with a soul.
Google says third-party cookies are staying. Still, look after your first-party data.
Retailers are all turning into media. One campaign, many platforms. Do the reports even match?
A new shop in an old district teamed up with the old shops next door. Visits rose 2.2x.
Customers complain: something this simple, why can't I set it on my phone instead of calling?
In 2022, sports spending in Taiwan topped NT$100B. Participatory sports grew the most.

name: Algorithm Nights FM 20.25
ticker: TV isn't dead! Targeting ages 30 and up, TV CPM is only around 48.
A nice Brand Lift might just be lighting up people who already love you.
Among 15- to 24-year-olds, TV reach is still over 70%.
Customers swipe through five deals and end up saying: just pick one for me.
An old cookie brand tried short video on zero budget and got 249M impressions.
AI summaries are eating search. SEO, AEO, GEO: time for all three.
Speed isn't a moat. Leaving something that “can't be generated” is.

name: Agentic Late Night FM 20.26
ticker: Goodnight to everyone working late. Today's question: the closer brands get to AI, do they drift from people?
AI agent permissions have four levels: observe, recommend, decide, act. No need to unlock all at once.
A 0.89 correlation does not mean 89% accuracy. Make that clear to the client.
Ask AI which brand is good, then hit the forums for the downsides. That's us now.
Global cart abandonment is around 70%. Customers aren't uninterested, just not sure yet.
An 88-year-old grandma ran 100 meters, and nobody asked if she was made by AI.
An agent that doesn't know when to stop is far more dangerous than one that does.
The cranes at the Sky Tower Site are still lit. Goodnight to everyone still working late at A25.
